text: Level three, question six: compound interest minus simple interest on a sum for three years at ten percent is thirty-one rupees; find the sum. Question seven: the simple interest on a sum for two years is four hundred and eighty rupees, and compound interest minus simple interest for two years is forty-eight rupees; find the rate and the sum. Question eight: find the ratio of compound interest to simple interest on any sum for two years at ten percent.
